notes.no_frontend: This plugin has no member-facing surface. It is a one-time migration tool: one admin screen under Tools, a REST progress controller, and a WP-CLI command. front_routes is deliberately empty - do not fill it to make a template happy.
notes.correctness_gate: The smoke proves the plugin installs, boots and renders. It does NOT prove a migration is correct - that is established by running a real migration against the disposable docker fixture (docker/run.sh bp | migrate | verify | reconcile). See CLAUDE.md 'Verification - there is no PHPUnit suite'.
notes.bugs_column: This project's card table has a dedicated BI Bugs column for importer defects, separate from BuddyNext's own Bugs column (9990191646). File importer findings against BI Bugs.
